## Rule

Shift-to-origin: Find the bounding box of all non-background (ch1-9) pixels. Shift content so the top-left of the bounding box becomes (0,0). Mask out cells outside the half-size output (output rows 0..2h-1, cols 0..2w-1 where h,w are bbox height/width — note task384 uses half_offsets30 = [0,0,1,1,...] vs task310's plain offsets).

## Algorithm sketch

36 nodes (opset 10). Key:
1. `Slice(input, 1:10, axis=1) → ch_nonbg [1,9,30,30]` → ReduceMax(axis=1) → `nonbg [1,1,30,30]`
2. ReduceMax(nonbg, axes=[3]) → row_any [30]; ReduceMax(nonbg, axes=[2]) → col_any [30]
3. ArgMax row_any → y0 (top); ArgMax(col_any reversed) → x1_from_end → x1 = 29 - x1_from_end
4. `row_src = clamp(y0 + half_offsets30, 0..29)` (half_offsets = [0,0,1,1,...,14,14])
5. Gather(input, row_src, axis=2) → shifted_rows [1,10,30,30]
6. Gather(shifted_rows, col_src, axis=3) → shifted [1,10,30,30]
7. Mul(shifted, row_mask * col_mask) → output (zeros cells outside 2h × 2w window)

### crop_v1 decomposition (2026-05-30, measured cost 9617 = memory 9540 + params 77)

Floor reasoning — the canonical's three 18,000B full-canvas tensors are NOT
"algorithmically necessary" (the old don't-do note was wrong); they only existed
because the shift gathered on the full 30×30 canvas. Cropping to the always-9×9
grid + folding the mask into the gather index removes them:

| intermediate | dtype/shape | bytes | irreducible? |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `input_crop_f32` | F32 [1,10,10,10] | 4000 | yes — Slice output is F32 (input is F32); entry cost of any crop |
| `shifted_rows` | U8 [1,10,30,10] | 3000 | yes — half-shifted (30 out-rows × 10 crop-cols); the other gather axis is the free output |
| `input_crop_u8` | U8 [1,10,10,10] | 1000 | yes — 1-byte copy for the gather (gathered values are one-hot 0/1) |
| bbox+index tensors | mixed | ~1540 | mostly irreducible (offsets/half_offsets/src [30] INT64 + tiny scalars) |
| params (inits) | — | 77 | irreducible |
| `output` (2nd gather) | U8 [1,10,30,30] | 0 | **free — excluded model output** |

**Proven floor ≈ 8000** (the F32 entry-crop 4000 + half-shift 3000 + U8 crop 1000
are all forced by the architecture). crop_v1 at 9617 is **1.20× the floor** — the
~1600B gap is the bbox-detection + length-30 index tensors. Pushing below ~8k
would need a fundamentally different shift (e.g., avoiding the F32 entry crop,
which is impossible since Slice preserves the F32 input dtype). Stopped here per
the 1.1×-floor guidance (close enough; further surgery is high-risk for <0.2 LB).

Why the entry crop must be F32 4000B not smaller: the model input is F32 and
Slice preserves dtype, so the cheapest cropped entry is `[1,10,10,10] F32`. Casting
the full canvas to U8 first costs 9000B (worse). 10×10 (not 9×9) is required so the
folded-mask gather can point out-of-window cells at a guaranteed-zero row/col
(index 9), which makes the final gather the masked output directly (no Mul, no Pad).

## Don't-do log

- 2026-05-18 | `stack_task384_task049_task011_on_5755_05` (SHA prefix `6C837BAA`): submitted as 3-task stack with expected +4.28 LB → Kaggle scored 5728.60 = **-26.45 LB hidden-bad**. The follow-on stack_task049_task011 (without task384) ALSO lost -13.09 LB, so task049/task011 in the 2026-05-18 batch were also hidden-bad — see those tasks' don't-do logs.
- Do NOT replace `Slice+ReduceMax → nonbg` with `Sub(1.0, Gather([0])) → nonbg`: FAILS because padding cells outside the active grid have ALL channels=0 (ch0=0 too, not 1). The `1-ch0` approach incorrectly marks padding cells as foreground, causing the bounding box to span the full 30×30 grid. Verified failure: 0/266 match.
- The correct alternative is `ReduceSum(input, axis=1) - ch0 > 0 → Cast(F32) → nonbg`.
- ~~The shifted_rows [1,10,30,30] and shifted [1,10,30,30] are algorithmically necessary for the dynamic row/col shift; no further reduction without crop-to-size.~~ **DISPROVEN 2026-05-30 (crop_v1):** crop-to-9×9-grid + folding the mask into the gather index removes ALL three full-canvas tensors. The shift only ever reads the 9×9 grid; the 30-wide output dimension is the *free* graph output (second gather). cost 77211→9617. The "complex, risky" caveat was overcautious — the rewrite is byte-equal to canonical on 6275/6275 inputs (266 visible + 2000 fresh ARC-GEN + 4009 extreme).
- Do NOT confuse this crop_v1 (266/266 vs LIVE, byte-equal Path A) with the 2026-05-18 OFF-LIMITS stack candidate above — that was a *different, hidden-bad* candidate.
